mechanism_narrative: A lower level of the federal funds rate, indicative of accommodative monetary policy, compresses discount rates and boosts equity valuations, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: Rank IC for FEDFUNDS as a predictor of 5-day SPX returns is less than 0.03 over any 1-year rolling window, or 5-day returns when FEDFUNDS is below 4.0% are not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in the federal funds rate above 4.5%, signaling a tightening monetary cycle, leads to higher discount rates and reduced equity valuations, producing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are not significantly negative when FEDFUNDS exceeds 4.5% (t-test p > 0.05) or the Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 1-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous rise in unemployment rate and decline in employment growth signals a deteriorating labor market, reducing consumer spending and corporate earnings, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The interaction term (UNRATE change * PAYEMS change) does not have a negative Rank IC (less than -0.03) over any 1-year rolling window, or the average 20-day return when UNRATE rises and PAYEMS falls is not significantly negative (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: In a high-unemployment regime (UNRATE > 5.5%), a decline in the unemployment rate signals improving labor market conditions and rising consumer confidence, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The average 20-day return when UNRATE > 5.5% and UNRATE declines is not significantly positive (p > 0.05) or the Rank IC for UNRATE decline in high-unemployment regimes is less than 0.03 over any 1-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A higher level of housing starts, indicating strong consumer demand for housing, correlates with increased consumer spending and corporate earnings, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Rank IC for HOUST as a predictor of 20-day SPX returns is less than 0.03 over any 1-year rolling window, or 20-day returns are not significantly positive when HOUST is above its 12-month average.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in housing starts below 2000 thousand units signals a weakening housing market and reduced consumer demand, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are not significantly negative when HOUST < 2000 (t-test p > 0.05) or the Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 1-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In a low industrial production growth regime (INDPRO growth < 0.5% annually), a rise in industrial production signals a recovery in supply chain activity and manufacturing, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The average 20-day return when INDPRO growth < 0.5% and INDPRO rises is not significantly positive (p > 0.05) or the Rank IC for INDPRO growth in low-growth regimes is less than 0.03 over any 1-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous rise in inflation (CPIAUCSL) and decline in unemployment (UNRATE) signals an overheating economy, prompting the Federal Reserve to tighten monetary policy, which leads to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The interaction term (CPIAUCSL change * UNRATE change) does not have a negative Rank IC (less than -0.03) over any 1-year rolling window, or the average 20-day return when CPIAUCSL rises and UNRATE falls is not significantly negative (p > 0.05).
